title: The Coldfire That Quadruples
story: In the black-ice caverns under Mount Sable, a single pale flame called Haldrimere burns without heat — and every time a blade touches it, each flame splits into 4. Mr 6 watches a panicked guard strike it 3 times before he arrives, and the cavern is already glittering with cold little fires. Mr 6 raises a hand: "Stop swinging and start thinking."
question: Starting from 1 flame, after 3 strikes each flame has split into 4 — how many coldfire flames are burning now?
solution: After strike 1: 1 × 4 = 4 flames. After strike 2: 4 × 4 = 16 flames.
praise: You tracked the quadrupling — the trick is that it multiplies again on every strike, not just once.
hint: Multiply by 4 once for each strike, using the new total each time.
victory: Mr 6 refused to strike a fourth time, and 64 confused little flames, with nobody to copy, shivered together back into one sulking spark. "Arithmetic," said Mr 6, "is colder than you are."
imagePrompt: Sixty-four pale blue flames flickering across a glittering black-ice cavern while a small numeral-6 knight calmly holds his sword down and counts them, breath frosting in the eerie glow.
